1084-4279-7452.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-7452.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-7452.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

339-677-3967-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-1115-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

539-728-3249-3621.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-3621.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

2907-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, each Scute Swarm triggers, creating that many creature tokens.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-5468.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

224-1525-4913-7893.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-4913-7893.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

2459-3558-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2459-3558-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1394-2060-5147-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

618-7623.description:
Activate the mutated Sawtusk Demolisher and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

27-1169-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1618-2440-2554-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Third Path Iconoclast
1618-2440-2554-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Third Path Iconoclast triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2554-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Third Path Iconoclast. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

4875-6705-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog by paying {G}{U}
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Conspiracy, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
Repeat step 3.
4875-6705-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2060-3263-5455.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-3263-5455.description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {5}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If Crystalline Crawler has six or more +1/+1 counters on it to start the combo, this combo results in infinite colored mana.

Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.

2932-5220-5686-6900.notablePrerequisites:

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.

Repeat.

3234-3293-5412-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5412-6798.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5412-6798.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.

570-2608-5921--108.easyPrerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.
570-2608-5921--108.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Holding priority, activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
570-2608-5921--108.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any permanent(s) using Derevi's trigger. The card you use to clone / copy Derevi must not bypass the legend rule. The copy must be legendary and have Derevi's name for the legend rule to take effect appropriately.

Gain life.

Animation Module triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and The Core.

957-1692-3662.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U} available the first turn, with {1}{R} each extra turn
957-1692-3662.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Izzet Chemister.

Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat from step 2 (note that you may divide these steps among your multiple extra turns to reduce the mana requirements down to the amount shown in the prerequisites).

Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.

Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.

Put Bladewing from the battlefield into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cursed Mirror's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing from the battlefield into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

The Eternal Witness tokens enter the battlefield, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Repeat.

When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.

Sacrifice Cathodion to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion and Butcher of Malakir trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Butcher of Malakir's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
